answer: Each new agent identity must solve a memory-hard compute puzzle costing 10 GPU-hours to mint, and each additional identity doubles the puzzle difficulty, so k fakes require 10·2^(k−1) GPU-hours — exponential scaling. On our oasis testnet this cost is priced in jade token vouchers burned at mint, so a voyage of 8 sybils costs ~1,280 GPU-hours, making bulk attacks uneconomical.
